text:
alice: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we need owners on the remaining action items and a ticket trace for the recurring cache-thrash pattern.
ben: I can own the cache eviction play, creating a Jira and tracking fixes.
diane: Please include clear acceptance criteria and any eval prompt we use to validate.
pm-bot: Jira ticket RW-3482 created by @ben — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-3482
carla: I will onboard docs and the rollout checklist for RW-3482. @ben will remain assignee for the code change.
ben: Timeline proposal: PR by Fri EOD, internal review Mon, canary Tue (if no blockers).
evan: Can someone map the previous two incidents to the same root cause? I see similar KV cache growth patterns in logs.
alice: @evan please paste the grep/queries you used so we can attach diagnostics to the ticket.
evan: grep snippet to find big kv entries:
```
# find top kv cache entries
grep -R "kv_cache_size" /var/log/redwood/* | sort -n | tail -n 50
```
alice: Nice. @evan please add that output to RW-3482 under Diagnostics -> Observations.
carla: Drafting RACI: Ben=R, Carla=A, Evan=C, Alice=I. I'll add that table to the ticket and link the postmortem.
ben: Handing docs/rollout to @carla; I still own the bugfix PR and will coordinate reviews.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod at 2026-04-02T18:00Z by @carla
diane: Quick check — any cross-team blockers (security, infra quotas)?
carla: No security blockers for the patch itself; KMS rotations are separate and not in scope.
alice: Let's do a short sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to close outstanding items. If no blockers we aim to close the PM ticket by next Wed.
ben: ack :thumbsup:
carla: ack
pm-bot: Reminder created: follow-up meeting RW-3482 — 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC
